name: Tanzanian Sweet Fried Spaghetti
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Heat a few tbsp of oil in a frying pan.
Add the spaghetti and fry it until golden.
Add the water, sugar, cardamom, salt, and raisins.
Cover the pan and cook until the pasta has absorbed the water, stirring occasionally. If necessary, add more water.

culture.text: Spaghetti is a long, thin, solid, cylindrical pasta. It serves as a staple food of Italian cuisine and is made of milled wheat and water, with the standard Italian version using durum-wheat semolina. The pasta is usually white because refined flour is used, but whole wheat flour may be added. Spaghettoni is a thicker form of spaghetti, while spaghettini is a thinner form. Capellini is a very thin spaghetti, while vermicelli is intermediate.
